bodyTextSnippet: < Before you start Your context stays on your phone. To answer in your own words, an abstracted summary of your question reaches a private language model. Here’s exactly what does and doesn’t leave. ✓ Your shelf, routine and all conflict logic run on-device. ✓ The cloud model is zero-retention and no-training, and no transcript is kept beyond a short, encrypted safety window you consent to. ✕ Never a raw photo, never a faceprint, never sold or shared. A separate advisor consent. Distinct and revocable. Enable Ask RoutineKind Off by default Pro-gated · hard trial cap · the answers about your own shelf are always free Open Ask RoutineKind
